title: SP Baby
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Job-hunting Tamaki Hasegawa misses an interview to stop an assault on a man who turns out to be Kagetora Sugo, the prime minister's nephew, and he asks her to become his bodyguard; unknown to her, they have met before (Viz blurb via MangaUpdates and AniList). A two-volume josei romantic comedy by Maki Enjouji; MangaUpdates tags list an orphaned, poor heroine, a rich and aggressive male lead, a stolen kiss, bullying, sexual harassment, attempted murder and past trauma, and note it was cancelled.
life_message: It suggests that courage and hard work can earn a place, and that a shared past can turn into love.
